It should hug the body naturally while showing small realistic tension wrinkles around the chest side, waist, elbows and wrists. Pair it with pale cool-gray or softly silver-gray high-waisted fitted athletic leggings with a soft matte to faint satin finish. The leggings should follow the natural waist, hips and legs without looking glossy, latex-like or synthetic-plastic.  Her figure should be slender with a believable athletic curve: a relatively narrow waist and more visual volume through the hips and legs, while preserving realistic human anatomy rather than creating an exaggerated hourglass. The chest should only be naturally outlined through the fitted top without adding exposure or artificially increasing volume.  Visible skin must remain limited mainly to the side of the face, ear, jaw area, and the hand and fingers holding the phone. The high collar covers most of the neck, while the chest, waist, abdomen, hips, buttocks and legs remain fully covered. Use a light-to-medium warm skin tone with subtle peach-beige and golden undertones under warm indoor light. Keep the skin fine and smooth-looking but realistically textured, visually suggesting clean, soft, naturally dry-satin human skin rather than wax, porcelain or plastic. Add a dark rectangular smartwatch and a small red-brown beaded bracelet on the visible wrist, plus a white wireless earbud or light-colored ear accessory. Her legs stand naturally close together with weight shifted slightly to one side, creating a subtle asymmetric S-curve through the shoulders, waist and hips. It should feel like an instinctive selfie stance rather than a rigid fashion-model pose.  The most important compositional feature is the two-level mirror-reflection structure. The main reflection occupies the middle and lower portion of the image and shows the woman from her head to around the upper thighs. A second, more distant reflection of the exact same woman appears across the upper section, revealing more of her rear body, lower legs and white athletic sneakers. A horizontal brass-gold mirror frame, architectural rail or divider runs across the composition and separates these two reflection zones. In the upper reflection, show medium-to-dark gray hard flooring and a noticeable vertical mirror seam. Both reflections must obey physically consistent mirror logic: body direction, phone placement, head angle and accessories must correspond correctly. Never turn the upper reflection into another woman, and never create duplicate limbs, extra hands, legs or fingers.  The lower background is dominated by a light-absorbing matte black wall. On the right, place a large orange-yellow geometric brand-like wall graphic with thick black internal shapes and lines, but do not require readable lettering. In the upper mirror area, show the gray gym floor with perhaps one small pale bottle or incidental object far away. Preserve small environmental imperfections such as mirror seams, tiny scuffs, wall marks and floor blemishes. If a social-media screenshot feeling is desired, a tiny white watermark-like shape may remain near the lower-right edge, but do not reproduce any real username, number or readable account information.  The photography must feel like a real phone image rather than commercial studio work. Use an approximately 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone main-camera perspective in a 3:4 vertical crop. The small phone sensor should create relatively deep depth of field, keeping the woman, the black-wall graphic and much of the upper reflected floor fairly sharp. Avoid portrait-mode blur. Mild computational HDR, limited digital sharpening, subtle denoising, JPEG compression and faint digital grain are welcome. Keep the framing slightly imperfect and off-center rather than perfectly symmetrical.  Illuminate the scene mainly with warm-white gym ceiling spots and overhead fixtures positioned above and slightly in front of the woman. They create compact highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheek, ear, fingers and the ivory fabric, with shadows falling softly downward. The gray flooring contributes a faint cool-gray environmental bounce, while the matte black wall absorbs much of the stray light, allowing the pale clothing and warm skin to separate naturally from the background. Do not add cinematic rim lighting, dramatic backlights or large studio softboxes.  The emotional residue should be understated, private and quietly confident, like a personal workout check-in rather than an advertisement. She had just paused during or after training to record herself; she is checking the mirrored composition on her phone now; in the next moment she may lower the phone and continue training or leave. Preserve mirror seams, slight framing errors, incidental reflections, flyaway hairs, natural fabric creases, minor surface marks and digital noise so the result feels like a real social-media fitness mirror selfie instead of a polished campaign photograph. 人物位于高级居家卧室的沙发旁，身体轻微侧转约 15–30°，上半身略微向沙发方向倚靠。一只手自然扶在沙发靠背或扶手上，另一只手可轻触高马尾、整理西装衣襟、轻搭腰侧或自然垂落。手指纤细修长，指节自然清晰，动作松弛、优雅，像刚回到卧室准备休息时被偶然记录下来的一瞬间。

prompts.text:
Catching the express train. 🚂 

Prompt: 
Square-format levitation photograph: a woman with the face from the reference photo hangs fully horizontal in mid-air alongside a moving freight hopper car, gripping the wagon’s side ladder with one outstretched hand while her entire body floats parallel to the ground, rigid and extended, physically impossible, and that declared impossibility is what makes it surreal rather than documentary. Pose: completely horizontal and relaxed, left arm stretched out holding the ladder rung, right arm extended forward with the hand loose, legs together and straight with the feet pointed, head turned toward the camera with a completely neutral expression, eyes looking straight into the lens from under the backwards cap; no visible strain anywhere in the body, and that total relaxation is what makes the image unsettling instead of heroic; the clothing shows no wind deformation, obeying gravity instead: the open jacket’s front panels hang downward toward the rails in resting folds, the silver chains and pendants dangle straight down from the neck, and the wide denim legs drape and sag toward the ground rather than streaming backward, that quiet downward pull confirming the stillness of a body that should be flying. Motion: pronounced horizontal smear across the background, trees, a concrete retaining wall, grass and fencing dissolving into directional bands, while the sky and clouds, being far away, stay almost sharp; that difference in smear intensity by distance is correct and carefully resolved, near things blurring more than far things; the rails in the lower foreground also drag; the wagon and the subject stay tack-sharp, travelling with the camera. Lighting: direct mid-afternoon sun from above and slightly behind-left; a rim along the extended arm and shoulder where the corduroy wales catch the light as fine parallel highlights, the crown of the backwards cap lit from behind, soft shadow under the brow, and defined modelling in the heavy denim folds; broad fill bounced from the pale concrete and the sky so the shadows stay open and hold detail in the black fabrics; medium contrast, typical of a clear day with bright surfaces around. Camera: square or near-square framing, level with the suspended body, perpendicular to the side of the train; medium-long focal length with no distortion; the body crosses the frame horizontally from left to right, the gripping hand in the left third and the feet exiting toward the right edge; the hopper car fills the entire left side as a vertical anchoring mass, counterweighting the horizontal of the body in a clean compositional cross. Depth: four planes, rails in the low foreground, smeared; the wagon and subject sharp; the midground wall and fence heavily smeared; the skyline of low buildings and sky almost still. Wardrobe (womenswear): a boxy black fine-wale corduroy zip-up jacket with a stand collar, a silver metal zip left open, a small black rectangular patch on the chest, ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem; a washed charcoal-black crew-neck t-shirt; layered silver chains, one with a small cross pendant and one with a lettered pendant; a chunky silver cuff bracelet on one wrist; a distressed dark brown leather belt with a silver double-prong buckle and metal grommets; extremely wide baggy jeans in a faded black wash with grey whiskering and worn fading at the thighs, embroidered with white spider-lily flower motifs in fine linework, a long chain of flowers running down the entire outer right leg and a smaller cluster at the upper left thigh; clean white low-top leather sneakers; and a black baseball cap worn backwards with small white embroidered logos. Grade: warm and slightly desaturated, yellows lifted in the grass and concrete, the sky held as a soft washed pale blue; lifted blacks turning the corduroy and denim into rich charcoal that still holds texture; the white embroidery, sneakers and cap logos held as soft creamy whites below clipping.

Show the woman lying naturally on a large green lawn. Shoot from a very low position with a 0.5× ultra-wide lens, around 14–16mm equivalent. Use a strong 25–35° Dutch angle.

Keep the signature pose: one arm reaches directly toward the lens so the open hand becomes a large foreground element; the face stays clear in the midground; both legs extend diagonally toward the upper corner of the frame, creating strong near-big / far-small perspective.

Make the legs look long and elegant: slightly offset the two legs instead of tightly overlapping them, with one slightly higher than the other, knees naturally extended, and a continuous line from thighs to ankles.

The foreground hand should feel dramatic but should not cover too much of the body.

Hair should be naturally loose on the grass with soft volume, flyaway strands, and a light breeze. Use realistic skin texture, natural facial features, lively eyes, authentic fabric folds, and believable outdoor sunlight.

Background: spacious summer lawn, blue sky, distant modern city architecture, trees, and subtle urban infrastructure. Keep the environment bright, airy, and believable.

Style: realistic lifestyle fashion photography, spontaneous summer snapshot, strong depth, playful interaction with the camera, subtle film feel.

rough concrete × cool blue ambient light × smartphone direct flash × sharp feminine styling × refined hosiery.

人物身形为丰腴自然曲线型，胸部饱满自然，胸前轮廓通过贴身吊带家居裙和轻微前倾姿态自然可见，胸腰比例协调，腰线清晰但真实，腰胯转折自然，臀腿线条圆润流畅，肩颈线柔和，整体身体比例健康协调。线条强调中偏强，但必须通过整理行李的前倾动作、贴身衣料和真实室内光线自然体现，不靠夸张扭腰、挺胸或刻意摆拍。

服装为深灰蓝色修身吊带家居短裙，细肩带设计，柔软贴身棉质或针织面料，裙身自然贴合身体，带轻微褶皱和真实穿着痕迹，胸前、腰腹和裙摆位置有自然受力变化，整体是普通居家睡裙 / 家居裙质感，不要时装大片感，不要过度暴露。

人物站在打开的黑色行李箱旁，身体轻微前倾并偏向镜头，一只手拿着折好的深色或灰色衣服，另一只手伸向行李箱内正在整理衣物或扶着行李箱边缘。视线自然落在行李箱内，不直视镜头，神情安静专注。站姿要稳定真实，双脚完整落地，重心明确，骨盆、胸腔和肩膀方向基本一致，只做轻微前倾，不反向扭腰，不夸张摆姿。行李箱内可见折好的 T 恤、睡衣、条纹衣物、浅色衣物和网格隔层，增强真实收拾行李的叙事感。

重点保证人物肢体完整自然，双手结构清晰，手指数量正确，手腕与手肘关节合理，肩膀放松，双腿比例正常，站姿受力明确，不出现手脚畸形、身体扭曲、悬空站姿或错误透视。拿衣服的手与整理行李的手要动作分明，前倾整理动作要像真实生活中的自然停顿，而不是刻意摆拍。

光线采用真实凌晨卧室室内灯光，主要来自床头灯、台灯和房间暖色环境灯，色温偏暖但不过度橙黄；窗外夜景保持较暗，可见零散城市灯光。人物面部、肩颈、锁骨、胸前、手臂和腿部有普通室内灯造成的自然高光，同时保留局部阴影、轻微曝光不完美、暗部噪点和真实明暗反差，不使用柔光箱，不使用商业轮廓光，不使用电影布光，不做过度 HDR。

整体必须呈现明显 iPhone 手机普通模式随手拍摄感：真实手机主摄视角，接近 24–28mm 等效广角，普通自动曝光，真实自动白平衡，轻微手机算法锐化，轻微低清感，允许轻微噪点、轻微失焦和非完美构图。人物与行李箱、床铺、衣架杆、墙面照片和夜晚窗景都保持清晰可辨，不使用人像模式，不做大光圈背景虚化，不做电影景深，不做商业摄影精修。

第一眼真实记忆点是：凌晨安静的卧室里，一个五官自然漂亮、身形丰腴柔和的年轻东方女性，穿着深灰蓝色修身吊带家居短裙，站在打开的黑色行李箱旁，一只手拿着折好的衣服，另一只手整理箱内物品，身体轻微前倾并偏向镜头，神情低垂专注，背景是凌乱床铺、衣架杆和夜晚城市窗景，像真实生活中用 iPhone 随手拍下的一张照片。

人物气质安静、松弛、温柔、放空、治愈，像傍晚一个人给植物浇水时被随手拍到的真实瞬间。五官方向为真实生活中长得很好看的年轻东方女性，柔和鹅蛋脸，面部轮廓自然流畅，清亮杏眼，眼神温和安静，带一点若有所思和轻微放空感，鼻梁清秀流畅，唇形自然柔软，仅有轻微淡妆，五官比例协调但保留轻微自然不对称，不要网红脸，不要商业模特脸，不要过度精修。皮肤白皙自然，保留轻微毛孔、轻微肤色不均、轻微面部纹理和真实生活状态，不磨皮，不塑料皮，不瓷娃娃感。

发型为黑色长发随意盘成松散丸子头，头顶发髻略微蓬松，额前和脸侧保留自然碎发，呈现真实居家状态，不做过度精致造型。人物身形为丰腴自然曲线型，胸部饱满自然，胸腰比例协调，腰线清晰但真实，腰胯转折自然，臀腿线条圆润流畅，肩颈线柔和，整体身体比例健康协调。线条强调中偏强，但必须通过修身家居服、轻微侧背站姿和自然窗边光线来体现，不靠夸张扭腰、挺胸或刻意摆拍。

服装为鼠尾草绿色修身短袖家居上衣，柔软罗纹针织面料，轻微贴身，能够自然勾勒上半身与腰线轮廓；下身为奶白色柔软家居短裤，轻薄柔软，裤边略带卷边或抽绳细节，整体为日常家居穿搭，不要时装大片感。人物站在花架旁，一只手拿透明小喷壶或浇水壶，另一只手轻扶绿植叶片，身体轻微侧背向镜头，重心自然落在一条腿上，另一条腿放松辅助支撑，肩膀放松，背部与腰臀轮廓自然形成柔和曲线，随后轻轻回头看向室内或镜头方向，姿态松弛稳定。抬手浇花的动作自然拉长肩颈与腰侧线条，侧背视角自然呈现腰臀轮廓，不做复杂动作。

光线采用真实黄昏窗边自然光与室内暖灯混合照明，窗外晚霞提供柔暖侧逆光，室内台灯和环境灯提供轻微暖色补光，面部、肩颈、手臂、腰侧和腿部有自然高光，同时保留少量真实阴影、轻微曝光不完美和真实明暗反差，不使用柔光箱，不使用商业轮廓光，不使用电影布光，不做过度 HDR。整体色调温暖、柔和、生活化，保留黄昏的松弛感。

The background is a minimalist gray-and-white modern residential hallway. No fisheye effect and no strong background blur. The subject must have a very clearly defined, full hourglass/pear-shaped adult female figure. This is the highest priority. She has a medium-to-small frame, moderately narrow shoulders, and a noticeably full upper body, with a large bust that shows natural weight and gravity. Her torso narrows rapidly beneath the bust into a distinctly slender waist, while her abdomen is flat but softly natural. Her pelvis is extremely wide, with the hips visibly expanding outward on both sides. Her buttocks are exceptionally full, thick, and rounded, and her upper thighs are thick and soft. However, everything must remain consistent with realistic pelvic anatomy, soft-tissue compression, and gravity. Avoid a muscular fitness-model butt, unnaturally spherical buttocks, or a slender fashion-model body. Use a low, side-seated pose similar to the reference-image style. Her buttocks rest fully on the carpet as she sits laterally toward her left. Her pelvis is rotated distinctly toward the camera, making the hip, buttock, and thigh closest to the camera the most prominent contours in the image. One leg is bent deeply in front of her body and extends diagonally toward the lower-left corner of the frame. The lower leg angles forward, with the foot planted or the shoe sole lightly touching the carpet. The other leg folds behind her body, with the knee close to the floor, creating visible compression between the thigh and buttock. The seated pose must produce realistic spreading and compression of the soft tissue in the thighs and buttocks; the legs and hips must not look stiff as though she were standing. Her upper body remains fairly upright but leans slightly backward. The waist is strongly drawn inward, producing a very pronounced waist-to-hip curve. Her shoulders rotate slightly toward her left, while her head and phone turn toward the mirror. With her right hand, she holds a black smartphone vertically at approximately eye level, covering the center and upper portion of her face. Her fingers wrap naturally around the side of the phone. The face-obscuring phone is an essential feature—do not create a front-facing selfie with her face visible. She has extremely long, straight, jet-black hair reaching her waist or lower. Her hair is dense and smooth, lying close to her back, with naturally tapered ends. Use a near-center part or a subtle off-center part, with no obvious curls. Most of the hair falls from the back of her head down her back and waist, with a few loose strands resting naturally around her shoulders and neck. No short hair, curls, bun, or high ponytail. She wears a tight-fitting black-and-cream long-sleeved top or mini-dress-style bodysuit. The main body is made from fitted black stretch fabric, with black structured detailing over the bust, while the sleeves are solid cream or ivory white, creating a strong black-and-white contrast. The neckline is relatively low, and the black bodice closely follows her full bust and narrow waist. The garment continues below the waist into an extremely short black skirt or hem positioned above and around the hips. On her legs, she wears white or very pale cream, ultra-sheer thigh-high stockings. The stocking tops sit high on the thighs. The material should resemble approximately 10–20 denier hosiery, with clearly visible translucency and the natural skin tone showing through. The stocking on the leg closest to the camera should retain a soft, milky-white appearance. The bands should be narrow and delicate. No thick cotton socks and no black stockings. She wears glossy black patent-leather pointed-toe stiletto pumps with intense mirror-like reflections. The toes are extremely pointed, and the slender heels are approximately 9–11 cm high. The shoe closest to the camera is positioned in the lower-left foreground, with its pointed toe directed sideways toward the left. The other shoe is located below and in front of her body, with the toe pointing toward the camera and the slender heel clearly visible. Both shoes must be the same style of black patent-leather pointed-toe stiletto pump. No ankle boots, platforms, or chunky heels. Her overall proportions should closely match the reference-image style: a relatively short torso, high waistline, wide pelvis, and exceptionally full upper thighs. In the side-seated position, the buttocks should visibly project backward and outward, while the thigh closest to the camera should have substantial visual width. Do not make her look like a fashion model with excessively long legs, small hips, a small butt, or broad shoulders. The setting is a minimalist modern residence or apartment hallway just outside a bedroom. The floor is fully covered by a light gray, short-pile carpet with a fine, soft texture. The background walls are cool gray-white. In the left rear of the image, include a white interior door and doorframe, with simple rectangular panel detailing. Farther back, another pale gray-white door and a short section of hallway are visible. In the upper-right area of the wall, include a small black wall sconce or candle-style wall light, only partially visible. The space should be minimal, clean, and almost completely free of furniture. A very small white decorative symbol may appear on the wall behind her, near the right side of the phone—for example, simple characters such as “^_^ <3.” It must be tiny, close to white in color, and only a subtle decorative detail rather than a visual focal point. If the model cannot generate the text reliably, omit it. Use soft indoor natural light or broad diffused lighting, with no obvious flash. The overall exposure should be slightly gray and low in saturation. The pale gray walls and carpet should appear bright and soft, while the black clothing and black hair create strong contrast. Her skin tone is naturally warm and fair, with very soft shadows. Avoid harsh lighting and a commercial studio look. Fine details should remain visible in the carpet fibers, black fabric, white sleeves, translucent stockings, reflective patent-leather shoes, and long hair. Use a soft gray tone and slightly low contrast, with no cinematic filter. prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：如 Scent / Form / Motion / Hydration
【英文标题】：如 SCENT INTERVAL
【核心主体】：如香水 / 时装人物 / 运动鞋 / 精华瓶
【左侧巨大材质】：
【右侧巨大材质】：
【中央负空间氛围】：
【主体位置与状态】：
【品牌名】：
【产品名 / 系列名】：
【主色调】：
【辅助文案】：
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一张高端商业 Editorial Design 海报，采用「夹缝构图 / Interval Composition」。

画面左右分别由两个尺度巨大的商业材质实体进入画幅，并被画面边缘裁切。两侧主体向中央挤压，在中间形成一条从顶部贯穿到底部的狭窄纵向负空间。中央负空间是整张海报真正的视觉主角。

裂隙不要完全笔直，可以呈缓慢自然的 S 型收放关系：顶部略宽，中部收紧，下部再次打开。内部保持干净、明亮、有空气感，不填入复杂背景。左右巨大材质使用【左侧巨大材质】与【右侧巨大材质】，重点表现真实的大尺度结构、连续纹理和高级商业材质感，不要让微小纹理压过整体构图。

始终遵循：先看到巨大材质关系，再看到主体细节。

两侧主体可以形成轻微差异，例如一侧更深、更重、更硬朗，另一侧更浅、更柔和、更透光，避免完全镜像。在中央负空间中下部加入【核心主体】，主体状态使用【主体位置与状态】。主体可以是产品，也可以是人物，但不要把中央空间完全塞满，主体上方必须保留足够空气，让“夹缝构图”依然清楚成立。

主体可以轻微越过中央负空间边界，与左右材质产生局部重叠或遮挡关系，让主体真正参与构图，而不是简单贴在中间。

使用大型英文 Serif Typography：【英文标题】标题横跨左右材质与中央负空间。

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 vertical high fashion editorial poster.

TITLE: [insert title]
SUBJECT: [describe the model, outfit, hairstyle and pose]
CORE VISUAL DEVICE: [optical refraction / breaking through a physical frame / graphic overlay / giant typography environment / other spatial interaction]
ACCENT COLOR: [insert one main accent color]
MOOD: [cold / elegant / experimental / cinematic / minimal]

Build the composition around the interaction between portrait photography and typography. The model should not simply stand beside the text. Make the typography physically participate in the image through overlap, masking, cropping, refraction, depth, foreground and background separation, or spatial interruption.

Use one strong visual mechanism per poster and make it immediately readable at thumbnail size.

Create a clear editorial hierarchy:

1. One oversized display title as the main graphic anchor
2. The fashion portrait as the primary photographic subject
3. A few meaningful editorial captions and credits
4. One controlled graphic or physical intervention

Use refined fashion typography, combining high contrast serif, condensed sans serif, modern grotesk, or subtle handwritten lettering. Large type can extend beyond the canvas and be partially hidden by the model. Small text should stay minimal, precise and meaningful rather than filling the page with random words.

Use an asymmetric editorial grid, bold cropping, generous negative space and strong scale contrast. Allow the model, type and graphic elements to move between foreground, middle ground and background.

Keep the palette restrained. Use mostly neutral tones such as ivory, soft gray, black or muted blue, with only one dominant accent color.

The portrait should feel like real fashion photography with natural skin texture, realistic fabric, believable hair and refined studio lighting. Avoid glossy CGI skin, excessive retouching and generic commercial modeling poses.

The final result should feel like an independent fashion magazine, experimental editorial campaign or art directed fashion poster, not a social media template.

Avoid meaningless filler text, excessive decoration, numbered labels, Vol or Issue numbering, sparkle symbols, random logos, cluttered layouts, cheap gradients and repetitive poster formulas.

prompt：https://promptsref.com/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/c8dd4e9b875306aefe4418816604a59e
An adult woman in an extremely close indoor smartphone selfie, vertical 9:16, seated or partially leaning beside a gray upholstered chair near a window. The phone is held slightly below eye level, roughly around upper-chest or shoulder height, pointing upward toward her face by only about 10–20 degrees. Keep the lens within arm's length, producing the believable close perspective of a 24–28mm-equivalent smartphone camera rather than an 85mm commercial beauty portrait. Her face occupies the upper half of the frame while her neck, necklace, deep black neckline, and upper torso fill the lower half; one shoulder and arm sit closer to the camera, creating subtle foreground enlargement.  Her head is gently leaned backward and tilted to one side, with the chin slightly raised and the neck naturally elongated. She looks toward the camera through oversized ultra-thin silver-gunmetal wire-frame glasses with a rounded or softly squared silhouette. Preserve subtle reflections from the nearby window in the transparent lenses instead of removing them completely. Because the camera is slightly below her, her gaze carries a faint downward-looking quality.  Preserve a soft oval face, natural jawline, gentle nose bridge, and naturally full but not exaggerated lips. Use understated taupe-gray and brown-gray eye makeup with thin black eyeliner extending gently along the outer corners. Avoid dramatic colored contacts or theatrical smoky makeup. Her lips remain naturally slightly parted, revealing only a tiny amount of teeth, with a muted dusty-rose, nude-rose, or soft mauve-pink color and a faint moist sheen. Her expression is quiet, languid, mildly absent-minded and unsmiling, like an unhurried private afternoon selfie.  Her medium-long to long hair is deep black to dark brown and worn loose with natural face-framing layers. Instead of a neat dense fringe, several irregular long strands fall across the forehead, glasses, cheeks, and neck. Keep the hair slightly voluminous, imperfectly tousled, and full of authentic flyaways and stray static strands. Where daylight passes through the camera-left side of the hair, allow subtle warm-brown or reddish-brown translucency and soft thin highlights. Do not give her a perfectly polished salon hairstyle.  She wears a fitted black long-sleeve ribbed knit cardigan-style top with fine vertical ribs, a central row of small black round buttons, and a deep U-shaped or softly squared neckline with the upper button area open. The fabric should remain soft, stretchy, and realistically knitted, showing natural tension, small folds, and changing rib spacing over the body. Do not convert it into leather, latex, or perfectly smooth synthetic fabric.  Visible skin includes the full face, part of the ear, neck, collarbones, upper chest, and the central chest area exposed by the low neckline. Preserve the original clothing coverage and neckline rather than deepening or altering it. Her skin is fair to light with a neutral-warm tone, reading as soft beige, light peach, and subtly warm under daylight rather than icy porcelain or saturated orange. Keep fine pores and minor natural tonal variation. The tactile impression should feel soft, fine, and naturally warm, with only a faint trace of natural sheen over the cheeks, nose tip, and upper chest.  Around her neck is a silver or gunmetal chain with several small gothic cross-shaped, pointed, and ornamental pendants, including one longer cross hanging naturally toward the center of the chest. The jewelry should carry a restrained soft-goth, Y2K, and vintage-metal mood without becoming oversized heavy-metal costume jewelry.  The dominant light source is a large window on camera-left. Use soft natural daytime window light around 5000K–6000K entering from the left-front side, illuminating the left hair, forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, lips, neck, and upper chest. The camera-right side of the face and the black clothing should gradually transition into soft shadow with no hard boundary. Allow a little transmitted light through hair near the window, but no flash, hard LED, artificial rim light, or professional three-point studio setup.  Keep the surrounding room recognizable. On the left is a bright white window edge or pale wall; behind her are large warm-gray beige curtains with vertical folds; on the right is a gray woven upholstered chair or sofa back. The environment should feel like a quiet apartment, hotel room, or private sitting area in daytime rather than a studio set.  Retain authentic smartphone computational-photography texture: moderate sharpening and mild denoising, but still visible individual hair strands, metal glasses edges, fine jewelry, ribbed knit texture, and believable skin. Keep most of the subject sharp while the curtains and chair soften only slightly; avoid extreme creamy bokeh.  The moment should feel as though afternoon window light had already entered the room. She had simply leaned beside the chair and held the phone a little lower than usual. Her hair had just been disturbed and never completely fixed again. Her chin is already lifted toward the lens, her gaze lingering there for one quiet second before she seems likely to lower the phone again. Preserve the final mood as languid, intellectual, soft-goth, very close and private, yet emotionally restrained and casually human-shot.  Negative prompt: mirror selfie, high-angle shot, passport portrait, perfect symmetry, golden hour, orange light, blue club lighting, studio flash, hard rim light, 85mm glamour portrait, plastic skin, poreless skin, excessive skin smoothing, bright colored contacts, heavy black smokey eyes, red lipstick, perfect salon hair, blonde hair, leather top, latex top, altered neckline, bright empty studio background, extreme bokeh, full body, visible legs.

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster built around the interaction between portrait photography, typography, structure, and physical space.

Subject: [male / female fashion model]
Outfit: [minimal tailoring / black fashion / white suit / structured styling]
Palette: [black + acid lime / ivory + burgundy / black + teal / custom palette]
Title: [TITLE]
Design direction: [oversized type / acrylic frame / vertical slicing / structural layout]

Start with a strong fashion photograph: realistic skin, refined facial features, expressive pose, detailed fabric, controlled studio lighting, and premium magazine quality.

Then make the graphic design physically interact with the subject instead of simply placing text around the portrait.

Directions:

• Oversized type × figure
Use extremely large typography that extends beyond the canvas. Let the subject pass in front of some letters and behind others, creating foreground/background depth.

• Acrylic form × spatial layering
Introduce a transparent glass or acrylic frame with visible thickness, reflections, edge highlights and subtle refraction. Let the subject touch, enter or intersect the structure.

• Vertical slices × portrait
Reconstruct one portrait through 4–5 unequal vertical image sections with visible gaps and subtle positional shifts. Keep the main facial features readable and attractive.

• Fashion × structural layout
Use a strong fashion pose, geometric color fields, oversized typography and architectural framing. Let the body, furniture, color blocks and type form one unified composition.

Keep typography bold but controlled: one dominant title, one short supporting phrase and minimal micro-text.

Use asymmetrical composition, strong scale contrast, intentional negative space, layering, cropping and selective color accents.

The final image should feel like a premium fashion campaign, experimental magazine cover or contemporary exhibition key visual.

I've used these character sheets as references (you can find the prompts in the quoted tutorial) + this prompt

Hyper-kinetic post-apocalyptic combat spectacle, extreme high-intensity CGI action, thick volumetric cinematic haze and golden-hour dust storms rolling through a massive sprawling junkyard settlement filled with denser crowds of background survivors, aggressive anamorphic 35mm lens with heavy motion blur, relentless handheld tracking and whip pans, deep shadows, heat distortion, ultra-realistic particle systems.

Use the provided character images as exact appearance locks: bald protagonist (exact face, blood streaks, silver puffer jacket, white hoodie, jeans), horned shaman chief (exact long horns, painted skull mask, bare torso, loincloth), yellow long-coat warrior (exact yellow skull mask, long black coat with red accents), yellow-hood warrior (exact yellow hood, white skull mask, spike backpack, bare chest), white X-mask warrior (exact white mask with red X, dreadlocks, brown rags). Lock all proportions, clothing and details. Larger crowded scrapyard settlement with more people fleeing and reacting in the background.

0-4s: [Extreme Wide Crash-In] Instant violent collision. Bald protagonist explodes forward through dense dust cloud and scattering crowds. Shaman chief swings a heavy bone club in wide horizontal arc. Impact detonates shockwave of scrap metal, dust and embers. No pause.

4-8s: [Dynamic Low Tracking] Rapid exchange. Bald protagonist ducks under the club, delivers spinning elbow to shaman’s ribs, then upward knee. Yellow long-coat warrior phases in from the side swinging a rusted metal pipe. Protagonist counters with a spectral energy pulse that rakes across the warrior’s chest. Fabric, ash and metal particles explode outward.

8-13s: [Orbiting Medium + Dutch Angle] Acrobatic mid-air clash. Bald protagonist vaults off the pipe, silver puffer fully whipping, lands dual-fist hammer blow to the yellow-hood warrior’s mask. White X-mask warrior retaliates with vertical spear slam that cracks the ground; protagonist rolls, rises into spinning back-kick that shreds more of the warrior’s rags into flying ribbons.

13-18s: [Handheld Close Combat Frenzy] Brutal ground scramble. Bald protagonist grapples the spear pole, headbutts the X-mask, then rips free and unleashes three distinct strikes: upward palm, horizontal elbow, downward axe-kick. Shaman absorbs then unleashes a tendril-whip of kinetic force that lashes the protagonist’s back, drawing blood and dust while background crowds scatter in panic.

18-23s: [Slow-Motion Impact Montage] Escalating power. Bald protagonist catches the bone club mid-swing, twists, drives knee into shaman’s midsection twice, then spinning heel kick that sends the figure airborne. Shaman crashes down in explosion of ash, metal and sand. Yellow long-coat and yellow-hood warriors advance without mercy, only to be met by expanding radial energy bursts.

23-28s: [Wide to Tight Push-In] Finishing sequence. Bald protagonist seizes the collapsing shaman by the horns, delivers a savage rising uppercut followed by a final two-handed overhead smash. The remaining three warriors are simultaneously blasted backward by a massive spherical kinetic explosion that shatters nearby shacks and sends crowds diving for cover. Debris and black-orange particles swirl across the settlement floor.

28-30s: [Hard Cut Reverse Extreme Close-Up] Blurred bald protagonist fills foreground, chest heaving, sweat and dust streaking his bloodied face, mouth open in ragged breath. Sharp deep background: the four masked warriors slowly rise from the wreckage, weapons reforming in hand, stalking forward with predatory stillness through the settling haze.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fabric physics and particle simulation, perfect motion blur, volumetric haze at maximum density, coherent anatomy and proportions, stable character consistency, cinematic color grade, movie-level VFX polish.

Enjoy it!! 🫡
